description: Complete the mandatory ownership verification for a Toolfound submission using the verification token (from the email magic link, or after placing the meta tag / DNS TXT record on your domain, this call checks them on demand). Verification is what makes Toolfound listings trustworthy: every launched product is confirmed maker-owned. On success your launch is queued on the date you were assigned.

token.description: Secret verification token for one submission, found in the email link or in the meta tag or DNS record snippet shown after submitting. Treat it as a credential and use it only for your own submission.

name: toolfound_verify_submission
title: Verify a submission
